McDonald's Collection 2015

Released November 27, 2015 · 12 cards

Expanded

McDonald's Collection 2015 is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Other series, released in English on November 27, 2015. It has 12 cards. It includes 12 Pokémon, 0 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).
